urban: relating to or concerned with a city or densely populated area
located in or characteristic of a city or city life
urbanize: The area was urbanized after many people moved in
impart urban habits, ways of life, or responsibilities upon
Birds are being urbanized by people in outdoor cafes feeding them
urbanized: made urban in nature; taking on urban characteristics
urchin: poor and often mischievous city child
urge: force or impel in an indicated direction
I urged him to finish his studies
The travel agent recommended strongly that we not travel on Thanksgiving Day
spur on or encourage especially by cheers and shouts
The crowd cheered the demonstrating strikers
urgency: the state of being urgent; an earnest and insistent necessity
an urgent situation calling for prompt action
I'll be there, barring any urgencies
his importunity left me no alternative but to agree
urgent: too pressing to permit of longer delay
urgently: health care reform is needed urgently
urging: a verbalization that encourages you to attempt something
the ceaseless prodding got on his nerves
the act of earnestly supporting or encouraging
his importunity left me no alternative but to agree
urinary: of or relating to the function or production or secretion of urine
of or relating to the urinary system of the body
urine: there was blood in his urine
urn: a large vase that usually has a pedestal or feet
a large pot for making coffee or tea
